subject: Mutual Action Plan: staged probe delivery, sandbox tokens & retention window
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: ops@brightcart.com <ops@brightcart.com>, dataops@probetest.com <dataops@probetest.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual Action Plan: staged probe delivery, sandbox tokens & retention window

Hi Lina / Raj,

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday — excited to move into a short MAP so we can timebox the evaluation and unblock the pilot contract. Attached is a proposed MAP (mpa-draft-v1.pdf) and a small manifest of the probe files we expect to deliver in two waves (brightcart_probe_manifest.csv). High-level asks/constraints from our side: 

- Wave 1 (T+3 business days): 250 annotated test cases + 25 representative prompt templates for front-door QA.
- Wave 2 (T+12 business days): 1k additional testcases + 100 prompt variations (ephemeral access).
- Sandbox: we will provision scoped tokens that expire after 30 days; these tokens are for evaluation-only and cannot be used to train or re-distribute assets.
- Retention: BrightCart should certify deletion from any persistent test stores 45 days after the MAP end date.

Can you confirm the following by EOD Thursday so we can lock dates into the SOW and provision tokens?
1) Acceptance gate: who on BrightCart will sign off the initial 250 cases (name & title)?
2) Any additional compliance requirements for the sandbox tokens (e.g., IP allowlists, IP ranges)?
3) Any redlines to the usage constraints in the manifest (we tried to keep them minimal).

If this looks good we'll update the MAP with the acceptance owners and ticketing hooks and follow up with a DocuSign link.

Thanks,

--
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
(415) 555-8942

Attachments: mpa-draft-v1.pdf (PDF, 240KB); brightcart_probe_manifest.csv (CSV, 12KB)

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the crisp plan. Quick answers inline:

On Tue, 1 Sep 2026 at 09:12, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai> wrote:
> - Wave 1 (T+3 business days): 250 annotated test cases + 25 representative prompt templates for front-door QA.
> - Wave 2 (T+12 business days): 1k additional testcases + 100 prompt variations (ephemeral access).

We can do the Wave 1 deliverable if T=receipt day is 9/6 (we're out for Labor Day). Wave 2 timeline is tight — can you push to T+18? We need time for internal review and de-identification.

> - Sandbox: we will provision scoped tokens that expire after 30 days; these tokens are for evaluation-only and cannot be used to train or re-distribute assets.

Agree on evaluation-only tokens. We will require an allowlist of IP ranges for the sandbox endpoints. I'll send our security contact details separately.

> 1) Acceptance gate: who on BrightCart will sign off the initial 250 cases (name & title)?

Acceptance owner for Wave 1: Raj Patel (Head of Data Ops). If he signs off, ops will accept the slice and move us to Wave 2.

> 2) Any additional compliance requirements for the sandbox tokens?

Yes — IP allowlist and a short AUP (acceptable use) addendum. I'll attach stub.

We should schedule a 30-minute alignment tomorrow to finalize dates and the DocuSign flow. Are you and Karthik free 9/2 at 10:00 PT?

Best,
Lina

Attachments: brightcart-security-stub.docx (DOCX, 18KB)

Lina / team,

Thanks — 9/2 10:00 PT works for us; I've scheduled a short sync and included a working agenda in the calendar invite. A couple of technical clarifications ahead of the call so we can provision correctly:

- Token scope: we'll issue per-project tokens limited to the eval model endpoint (no embeddings or admin scopes). Confirm if BrightCart needs separate tokens per environment (staging vs. prod).
- IP allowlist: please send CIDR ranges; we can add them to the temporary ACLs.
- Wave 2 timing: we can accommodate T+18 if BrightCart prefers that. We'll reflect the change in the MAP and push the DocuSign version once you confirm.

Also attaching a short 'sandbox-token-instructions.txt' that explains token rotation and expiry procedures.

Cheers,
Karthik Iyer
Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference
